title: Bagels
instructions: Mix flour, yeast, salt, honey, and warm water until a dough forms.
Knead for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Cover and leave to rise for 1 hour.
Divide into 8 balls, shape into bagels by pushing a finger through the center.
Boil in water with baking soda for 1 minute per side.
Bake at 220°C for 15-20 minutes until golden.
notes: Top with sesame or poppy seeds before baking if desired.

title: Banana Bread
keywords: sweet, cake, fruit, breakfast, afternoon tea
instructions: Preheat oven to 175°C and grease a loaf pan.
Mix mashed bananas and melted butter in a bowl.
Mix in sugar, egg, and vanilla.
Sprinkle in baking soda and salt, then fold in flour until combined.
Pour into loaf pan and bake for 50-60 minutes until a tester comes out clean.
notes: Add chopped walnuts or chocolate chips for extra texture.

title: Beef Chili
keywords: beef, dinner, spicy, beans, slow cook
instructions: Brown minced beef in a pot with onions and garlic.
Add cumin, chili powder, and tomato paste; stir for 1 minute.
Add chopped tomatoes and simmer covered for 30 minutes.
Stir in kidney beans and simmer uncovered for another 15 minutes.
notes: Serve over rice with sour cream and grated cheddar.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream together butter, brown sugar, and white sugar.
Beat in egg and vanilla.
Sift in flour and baking soda, then stir in chocolate chips.
Drop tablespoonfuls onto a lined baking sheet.
Bake at 180°C for 10-12 minutes until light brown.
notes: Let cool on tray for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack.

title: Classic Pancakes
ingredients: 1 tbsp sunflower oil plus extra for frying
instructions: Whisk flour, eggs, milk, oil, and salt together until smooth.
Heat a pan with a splash of oil over medium heat.
Pour a small ladle of batter into the pan and tilt to coat evenly.
Cook for 1-2 minutes until golden, then flip and cook the other side.
notes: Serve with lemon and sugar, or maple syrup and berries.

title: Garlic Butter Shrimp
instructions: Melt butter in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add shrimp, season with salt and pepper, and cook 2-3 minutes per side until pink.
Stir in lemon juice and parsley, then remove from heat.
notes: Delicious served over pasta or with crusty bread.

title: Spaghetti Bolognese
keywords: pasta, beef, Italian, dinner, comfort food
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan and brown the minced beef.
Add onion, garlic, and carrot; cook until soft.
Stir in tomato paste, chopped tomatoes, and oregano.
Simmer on low heat for 30-40 minutes.
Boil spaghetti according to package instructions, drain, and mix with sauce.
notes: Garnish with freshly grated Parmesan cheese.

title: Tomato Basil Soup
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil until soft.
Add tomatoes and stock; bring to a boil and simmer for 20 minutes.
Blend soup with fresh basil until smooth using an immersion blender.
Stir in cream if using, season to taste, and serve warm.
notes: Pairs perfectly with a grilled cheese sandwich.
